author: v16_c01_author
genre: Nontechnical research-reading instruction with a small original algebraic diagnostic, not a graduate technical theorem chapter.

coverage_review.search_strategy: Economic-object queries, synonyms, primary routes, inclusion/exclusion, three reading passes, honest saturation and actual bounded search log.
coverage_review.seminal_papers: Influential entry points separated from authority or correctness; concrete older linked works used to find a method branch without asserting historical priority.
coverage_review.frontier_updates: Dated four-state queue, actual2023 metadata/abstract candidate, explicitly pending full reading and recent-coverage limits.
coverage_review.evidence_tables: Completed two-paper table with actual draft locators, question/design/assumption/limit; publication metadata separate.
coverage_review.citation_chains: Actual Schnabl-to-Khwaja–Mian citation edge inspected; citation direction versus forward/backward discovery explained.

full_reading.scope: Read complete authored prose, actual two-paper evidence table, version register, synthesis, critical comparison, every original numerical statement, all8prompts/solutions and guides. Qualitative judgments are full author reading, not keyword counts.
full_reading.case1: Actual paper content inspection and version identity checked within explicit source scopes; no full replication or exhaustive novelty claim. No paper numerical estimates imported.
full_reading.case2: Read common/differential demand reasoning and exact observational equivalence; hypothetical index values do not claim real loan stocks or percentages. Methods critique is conditional, not a claim to have invalidated source papers.
full_reading.source_boundary: Every source-derived sentence confined to inspected scope; screened candidate never treated as methods-reviewed. Failed retrievals and screenshot limitations explicitly recorded.
full_reading.limitations: No external human certification; no rendered browser/mobile/keyboard/print inspection. Source PDFs remain remote links; offline chapter narrative and examples are self-contained.

exact_prompt_review.v16-c02-e1: Two query families, two inclusion gates, duplicate exclusion, priority, honest stopping and novelty boundary all answered.
exact_prompt_review.v16-c02-e2: Version identity/source/date/locator, later publication separate, changed-sample treatment and preservation answered without invented dates.
exact_prompt_review.v16-c02-e3: Allfour outcomes, two slopes, negative-index domain and equal-exposure undefined denominator resolved.
exact_prompt_review.v16-c02-e4: Exactfour outcomes, two slopes and observationally equivalent zero-u slope4; inference boundary explicit.
exact_prompt_review.v16-c02-e5: At leastfour distinct overreach errors and complete defensible replacement; no blanket fixed-effect dismissal.
exact_prompt_review.v16-c02-e6: Substitution reconciles distinct targets conditionally; concrete evidence needed to distinguish conflict.
exact_prompt_review.v16-c02-e7: Allfive document situations have identity/status/permissible-use entries; no document-count independence.
exact_prompt_review.v16-c02-e8: Complete synthesis separates source motivation from own witness, identifies missing data, update action and novelty condition.

numerical_review: Checker reads4input and9result groups; recomputes all displayed arithmetic and observational equivalences; alternative exposure/common-demand/slope/differential-demand menus test cancellation and contamination; invalid exact numeric and no-variation domains fail explicit guards under-O.

result.qualitative_scope: Full author reading and narrow source inspection recorded; independent root/peer review pending.

portable_execution.status: passed actual executions; final freeze rerun separately retained

open_findings: Independent root/peer review and canonical promotion remain pending.
canonical_promotion: Root path-only promotion from preserved working freeze; actual canonical gates recorded separately.
